why: Scores: base STR 15 DEX 14 CON 13 INT 12 WIS 10 CHA 8 plus Soldier (STR +2, CON +1) = STR 17 (+3), DEX 14 (+2), CON 14 (+2), INT 12 (+1), WIS 10 (0), CHA 8 (-1). Dwarf Fighter 3 + Sorcerer 4 (Draconic Sorcery), level 7. Dwarven Toughness: +1 HP per character level = 7. Draconic Resilience: +1 HP per Sorcerer level = 4 (+3 at level 3 and +1 for level 4). Base HP: Fighter level 1 = 10+2 = 12, levels 2-3 = 2x8 = 16, Sorcerer d6 4x(4+2) = 24, = 52. Total 52+7+4 = 63. Leather Armor 11+2 = 13 so no unarmored AC option competes.
